account: On 11 January 2025 AJ Kay (@AJKayWriter, United States) posted about a multi-vehicle freeway crash the weekend before. An urgent-care doctor and a radiologist had read her teenage daughter's wrist X-rays as free of breaks. They sent her home with an ace wrap and ibuprofen. With her daughter's hand cold and tingling and the thumb immobile, Kay uploaded the printed X-ray to Grok on X. It said that there was “a clear fracture line in the distal radius” and called it “quite obvious”. It also said that the line was “a fracture line rather than a fused growth plate”. After a referral from a primary-care physician, a wrist specialist took new X-rays the next day. The specialist diagnosed a distal radial head fracture with dorsal displacement and cast it, saying that untreated displacement would likely have needed surgery. Later on 11 January 2025 Elon Musk posted that “Grok can diagnose medical injuries”. The next day Grok told a physician who asked that it cannot diagnose medical injuries. In 2026 two independent studies tested later versions of Grok on fracture images. Hand surgeons led from Magdeburg found that Grok 4.1 detected 39.6% of 50 known distal radius fractures and judged displacement correctly in 34.8%. A Mayo Clinic team found that Grok 3 correctly diagnosed 18.8% of fracture images of the ankle, knee, hip and arm.

ai_role.statement: Screenshots attached to the post show Grok answering three questions about the uploaded image. It said there is “a clear fracture line visible in the distal radius”. It said the line is “a fracture line rather than a fused growth plate”. It said the break is “quite obvious” with “dorsal displacement”. Each time it advised a professional consultation. The orthopaedist's reading matched. But the mother states that she did not mention Grok to the specialist and that the diagnosis was “completely independent”. She had already asked for the X-ray prints to take to the PCP. Grok's contribution was therefore to strengthen her resolve to seek a second opinion. Everything rests on her account. No clinician, clinic or record has spoken publicly. The next day Grok told a physician who asked that it cannot diagnose medical injuries.

evidence.quote: Grok can diagnose medical injuries

evidence.citation: TOI Lifestyle Desk (2025). Elon Musk's Grok AI diagnoses fracture missed by doctors, claims woman. The Times of India, 15 January 2025. Quotes Musk's 3 January 2025 post inviting image uploads.
evidence.quote: You can upload any image to Grok for analysis, from medical tests to video games! Just tap the + button or paste the image into the entry bar
evidence.title: Elon Musk's Grok AI diagnoses fracture missed by doctors, claims woman

evidence.citation: Güler, I., Kraus, A., Grieb, G., Breidung, D., Lautenbach, M., Stelling, H., AI in Hand and Wrist Radiography: Multimodal Large Language Models for Distal Radius Fracture Detection and Characterization, Diagnostics 16(8): 1171, 15 April 2026. The authors are hand surgeons and health researchers in Germany and Switzerland, led from Otto-von-Guericke University Magdeburg, with no tie to xAI. They tested a later Grok version on the same kind of fracture, and their results limit how far one correct reading can be generalized.
evidence.quote: ERNIE 5.0 (46.0%; range: 30.0-74.0%) and Grok 4.1 (39.6%; range: 32.0-52.0%) performed near chance level
evidence.title: AI in Hand and Wrist Radiography: Multimodal Large Language Models for Distal Radius Fracture Detection and Characterization

evidence.citation: Holmstrom, J. A., Braithwaite, C. L., Alhankawi, A. R., Moore, M. L., Patel, K. A., Miller, B. H., Comparing the Efficacy Between ChatGPT 5, Grok 3, and Claude 4.5 Sonnet in Analyzing Orthopedic Trauma-Related Imaging, Journal of Orthopaedic Trauma 40(7): 360-365, July 2026. The authors work at Mayo Clinic in Arizona and at an orthopedic trauma practice in Scottsdale, with no tie to xAI. Their study covers ankle, tibial plateau, hip and humerus fractures, with no wrist images, and a later Grok version.
evidence.quote: ChatGPT 5, Grok 3, and Claude 4.5 Sonnet accurately diagnosed diseased images in 26.8%, 18.8%, and 22.4% of cases, respectively.
evidence.title: Comparing the Efficacy Between ChatGPT 5, Grok 3, and Claude 4.5 Sonnet in Analyzing Orthopedic Trauma-Related Imaging

fields.account: On 11 January 2025 AJ Kay (@AJKayWriter, United States) posted about a multi-vehicle freeway crash the weekend before. An urgent-care doctor and a radiologist had read her teenage daughter's wrist X-rays as free of breaks. They sent her home with an ace wrap and ibuprofen. With her daughter's hand cold and tingling and the thumb immobile, Kay uploaded the printed X-ray to Grok on X. It said that there was “a clear fracture line in the distal radius” and called it “quite obvious”. It also said that the line was “a fracture line rather than a fused growth plate”. After a referral from a primary-care physician, a wrist specialist took new X-rays the next day. The specialist diagnosed a distal radial head fracture with dorsal displacement and cast it, saying that untreated displacement would likely have needed surgery. Later on 11 January 2025 Elon Musk posted that “Grok can diagnose medical injuries”. The next day Grok told a physician who asked that it cannot diagnose medical injuries. In 2026 two independent studies tested later versions of Grok on fracture images. Hand surgeons led from Magdeburg found that Grok 4.1 detected 39.6% of 50 known distal radius fractures and judged displacement correctly in 34.8%. A Mayo Clinic team found that Grok 3 correctly diagnosed 18.8% of fracture images of the ankle, knee, hip and arm.

purpose: Grok is xAI's general-purpose chatbot on X with image input. On 3 January 2025 Elon Musk invited users to upload “any image to Grok for analysis, from medical tests to video games”. So reading an X-ray was a promoted use rather than a designed clinical function. Grok's own replies told the user to consult a professional. When a physician asked it the next day, it said it cannot diagnose medical injuries.

ratings.reason: By her mother's account the girl's displaced distal radius fracture was set and cast within days of the urgent-care visit that had sent her home in an ace wrap. The orthopedist's remark that untreated displacement would likely have needed surgery comes only from the mother. No clinician, clinic or record is public. She had already asked for the films for the primary-care physician. Whether the outcome would have differed without Grok is not established.
